author: grassmann
note: Append-only companion to the six create-once probe envelopes (ruling limit 3's parser/schema + recomputed-coverage fields; the envelopes were sealed at capture, so these notes bind to them by body sha rather than mutating them).

SELECTION_RECORDS/istanbul_marmara.parser: FDSN station text (pipe-delimited channel-epoch rows, '#'-prefixed header); presence = unique Station column values with an epoch active in the day window

SELECTION_RECORDS/socal_coachella.verdict: PROBE_REFUSED (HTTP 400 from SCEDC on the single authorized request; template BLOCKED pending a new ruling -- candidate causes for that ruling to weigh: SCEDC station-service parameter strictness on the sta-list/day-window combination)

SELECTION_RECORDS/turkey_kahramanmaras.verdict: TEMPLATE_GRAMMAR_CONFIRMED (10/11 presence on the historical probe day is an honest per-day presence signal, exactly the quantity the lane measures)

MF4_FEED/sym_h.parser: OMNIWeb high-res retrieval: HTML-wrapped fixed-width ASCII; data rows match ^YYYY DOY HR MN SYM_H; DOY 319 == 2025-11-15; values in nT
MF4_FEED/sym_h.verdict: TEMPLATE_GRAMMAR_CONFIRMED (var index 41 = SYM/H confirmed by value range and label block)

MF4_FEED/kp.verdict: PROBE_REFUSED (local SSL trust-store failure BEFORE any response -- an environment defect on the capture host, not endpoint evidence; template BLOCKED pending a new ruling; the ruling can authorize one retry with a proper CA bundle)

MF4_FEED/omni.parser: OMNIWeb high-res retrieval as sym_h; data rows ^YYYY DOY HR MN BZ_GSM FLOW_SPEED PROTON_DENSITY; fill sentinels 9999.99 / 99999.9 / 999.99 observed and must map to registered absence (None) at the boundary
